text: Okay, so we have a value of CRC computed at the receiver. That is a digest of what the receiver has understood. From the thing that we have received. Okay, now, at the receiver, we have both the CRC that was transmitted by the transmitter. And the CRC that the receiver has computed. If they are the same. So if they are equal, if they are the same, then the receiver says, I received everything correctly. Okay. If instead, the two values are different, then the receiver says, I failed. I cannot receive the packet correctly. Okay, so the packet transmission failed. Okay, now.
